_comment: Respellings applied to the SPOKEN block only, never to the on-screen
script, the caption, or anything a human reads. HeyGen's voice reads text
literally, so the only reliable way to fix a mispronunciation is to spell
the word the way it should sound.
Add a line here rather than editing the persona prompt. This runs as a
find-and-replace after the script is written, so it cannot be forgotten,
and a word added here is fixed for every future week.
